David Laing, writing from Hythe (Kent) says it was certainly good to receive the Mag, and the news letters from all the blokes is encouraging.
Frank King, caught a packet in the desert, but is making good progress. David Laing was married recently.
David Laing, stationed near the Cheviots, finds the "ups and downs" too awe-inspiring to attempt any running, and longs for the grassy flats of Wimbledon.
